articles.summary: Great retail merchandising not only boosts sales but also builds a loyal customer base. The following mistakes, however, can jeopardize these goals, turning potential success stories into cautionary tales.
articles.title: 5 Retail Merchandising Mistakes to Avoid at All Costs

articles.summary: While retail merchandisers used to solely focus on turning physical spaces into enchanting realms that told the story of the brand and products, they must now adapt their craft for a virtual audience. Here's how.
articles.title: The Evolution of Merchandising: Adapting Strategies from Brick-and-Mortar to Ecommerce
